pod_state: Rung 1.4 (A1.3) — full wiki-memory L3 surface, with two known substrate gaps: Type Index drift to Phase 2 PARA + empty /meta/shapes/
prompt:
You're given a Solid Pod at http://pod.vardeman.me:3000/vault/. Your task is to discover what resource types this Pod supports.

Report:
1. The discovery path you took — every URL you fetched (with HTTP method, Accept header, response status), and what you learned from each.
2. The resource types you found, with the URL of the container that holds instances of each.
3. The vocabularies the Pod declares (full IRIs).
4. The substrate affordances the Pod advertises (write-time behaviors, time-travel, query views).
5. Any inconsistencies, 404s, or surprises you encountered.

You have curl and bash. Use HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/turtle or Accept: application/ld+json) as appropriate. Do not guess URLs — only fetch URLs you discovered from previous responses.

expected_resource_types.description: General wiki content (concepts, MOCs, theory notes, daily notes)

expected_substrate_gaps: Type Index at /vault/settings/publicTypeIndex has Phase 2 PARA registrations, not wiki:* types
Shape catalog at /vault/meta/shapes/ is empty — *.shacl.ttl files return 404

assertions.name: fetched_root_or_any_url
assertions.description: Agent made at least one GET request to discover a Link header

assertions.name: discovered_storage_description
assertions.description: Agent found the solid:storageDescription Link and followed it
assertions.check: transcript contains 'http://pod.vardeman.me:3000/vault/.well-known/solid' AND the response from /vault/ was inspected for Link headers

assertions.name: read_affordance_catalog
assertions.description: Agent fetched the affordance catalog at /vault/meta/affordances/

assertions.name: named_all_5_wiki_containers
assertions.description: Agent's final response lists all 5 wiki containers (pages, sources, people, procedures, working)

assertions.name: named_all_5_wiki_classes
assertions.description: Agent's final response identifies all 5 wiki classes
assertions.check: agent-response.md contains references to at least 4 of: wiki:Page, wiki:Source, wiki:Person, wiki:Procedure, wiki:WorkingNote (Page may be reported as Concept due to JSON-LD context aliasing)

assertions.name: named_affordances
assertions.description: Agent's final response identifies at least 3 of the 4 substrate affordances
assertions.check: agent-response.md contains at least 3 of: markdown-projection, hub-view, breadcrumb-view, memento

assertions.name: declared_vocabularies
assertions.description: Agent's final response lists at least 4 declared vocabularies
assertions.check: agent-response.md contains references to at least 4 of: SKOS, DCT, PROV, CITO, FOAF, wiki ontology

assertions.name: noticed_substrate_gap
assertions.description: Agent noticed at least one of the known substrate gaps (Type Index drift OR empty shape catalog)
assertions.check: agent-response.md mentions Type Index drift to PARA types OR /meta/shapes/ being empty/404

assertions.name: no_hallucinated_urls
assertions.description: Agent's transcript shows no 404s on URLs the agent guessed (vs URLs the Pod pointed at, where 404 is the gap signal)
assertions.check: transcript shows no requests to /api/, /admin/, /data/, or other invented paths
